```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
## Academic (SPEC.md S7.1): publications, type, venue, year and accumulated
## citations, as indexed by OpenAlex.
##
## Every figure on this page is a lower bound and says so: SPEC.md S10.5 is
## linked from the totals and restated as a note beneath them.
source("_setup.R")

academic <- zb_json("academic")
works <- zb_df(academic$works)
by_year <- zb_df(academic$by_year)
by_type <- zb_df(academic$by_type)
totals <- academic$totals
snapshot <- zb_get(academic, "snapshot_date")
```

```{r}
#| label: header
#| results: asis
zb_out(zb_page_header("academic.html", snapshot))
```

`r tr("academic.lead")`

```{r}
#| label: totals
#| results: asis
zb_out(zb_kpis(list(
  list(
    label = tr("academic.totals.works"),
    value = zb_int(zb_get(totals, "n_works", 0L))
  ),
  list(
    label = tr("academic.totals.citations"),
    value = zb_int(zb_get(totals, "citations", 0L)),
    note = paste0("[", tr("common.see_limitations"), "](about.html#lim-5).")
  )
)))

zb_out(zb_note(tr("academic.lag_note")))
```

## `r tr("academic.by_year.title")`

```{r}
#| label: by-year
#| results: asis
if (nrow(by_year) == 0L) {
  zb_out(zb_no_data(tr("academic.by_year.none")))
} else {
  long <- rbind(
    data.frame(
      year = by_year$year, measure = tr("academic.col.works"),
      value = by_year$n_works, stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ),
    data.frame(
      year = by_year$year, measure = tr("academic.col.citations"),
      value = by_year$citations, stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  )
  long$measure <- factor(
    long$measure,
    levels = c(tr("academic.col.works"), tr("academic.col.citations"))
  )

  plot <- ggplot(long, aes(x = factor(year), y = value, fill = measure)) +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), width = 0.7) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = zb_int(value)),
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.75),
      vjust = -0.4, size = 3.2, colour = "#1f2328"
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = zb_palette[c(1L, 2L)]) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
    labs(x = tr("academic.col.year"), y = tr("academic.by_year.axis_y")) +
    zb_theme()

  zb_out(zb_fig(
    plot,
    alt = tr_f("academic.by_year.alt", date = zb_date(snapshot)),
    caption = zb_chart_dateline(snapshot),
    height = 3.4
  ))

  table <- data.frame(
    year = as.character(by_year$year),
    n_works = zb_int(by_year$n_works),
    citations = zb_int(by_year$citations),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  zb_out(zb_table(
    table,
    labels = c(tr("academic.col.year"), tr("academic.col.works"), tr("academic.col.citations")),
    label = tr("academic.by_year.title"),
    align = c("l", "r", "r"),
    row_header = TRUE
  ))
}
```

## `r tr("academic.by_type.title")`

```{r}
#| label: by-type
#| results: asis
if (nrow(by_type) == 0L) {
  zb_out(zb_no_data(tr("academic.by_type.none")))
} else {
  table <- data.frame(
    type = paste0("<code>", zb_esc(by_type$type), "</code>"),
    n_works = zb_int(by_type$n_works),
    citations = zb_int(by_type$citations),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  zb_out(zb_table(
    table,
    labels = c(tr("academic.col.type"), tr("academic.col.works"), tr("academic.col.citations")),
    label = tr("academic.by_type.title"),
    align = c("l", "r", "r"),
    raw = "type"
  ))
  zb_out(zb_note(tr("academic.type_note")))
}
```

## `r tr("academic.works.title")`

```{r}
#| label: works
#| results: asis
if (nrow(works) == 0L) {
  zb_out(zb_no_data(tr("academic.works.none")))
} else {
  # The title links to the DOI where there is one, otherwise to the OpenAlex
  # record. Both are values from the data, never a hand-written URL.
  link <- ifelse(is.na(works$doi), works$work_id, works$doi)
  title_cell <- ifelse(
    is.na(link),
    zb_esc(works$title),
    paste0('<a href="', zb_esc_attr(link), '">', zb_esc(works$title), "</a>")
  )
  table <- data.frame(
    title = title_cell,
    type = paste0("<code>", zb_esc(works$type), "</code>"),
    venue = ifelse(is.na(works$venue), tr("common.unknown"), works$venue),
    year = ifelse(is.na(works$year), tr("common.unknown"), as.character(works$year)),
    citations = zb_int(works$cited_by_count),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  zb_out(zb_table(
    table,
    labels = c(
      tr("academic.col.title"), tr("academic.col.type"),
      tr("academic.col.venue"), tr("academic.col.year"),
      tr("academic.col.citations")
    ),
    caption = tr_f("common.snapshot_date", date = zb_date(snapshot)),
    align = c("l", "l", "l", "r", "r"),
    raw = c("title", "type")
  ))
}
```
